text: Apple's fiscal third-quarter revenue increased 16 percent from a year earlier to 109.4 billion dollars.
Apple's diluted earnings per share rose 29 percent compared with the prior-year quarter.
Apple reported a record installed base of active devices across its major product categories.
Tariff refunds contributed roughly two percentage points to Apple's reported quarterly gross margin.
Apple's fiscal third quarter ended on June 27 in 2026.
Apple declared a cash dividend of 27 cents per common share.
Apple scheduled its results conference call for 2 p.m. Pacific time on July 30.
Microsoft Cloud revenue grew 27 percent in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026.
Revenue from Azure and other Microsoft cloud services increased 43 percent year over year.
Microsoft's More Personal Computing segment reported a four percent quarterly revenue decline from a year earlier.
Microsoft's Windows OEM and Devices revenue fell seven percent year over year.
Xbox content and services revenue dropped ten percent compared with the prior-year quarter.
Microsoft's quarterly announcement covered the three months ending June 30 in 2026.
Microsoft planned to discuss forward-looking guidance during its earnings conference call.
Microsoft's full-year operating income increased 21 percent to 155.2 billion dollars.
Intel reported a 25 percent year-over-year increase in second-quarter revenue.
Intel's quarterly GAAP net loss widened from 2.9 billion dollars to 11 billion dollars.
Intel's diluted GAAP loss per share increased from 67 cents to 2.16 dollars.
Intel's GAAP gross margin improved by 12.9 percentage points compared with the previous year.
Intel moved from a prior-year non-GAAP quarterly loss to a non-GAAP profit of 2.2 billion dollars.
Revenue in Intel's All Other business category fell 33 percent year over year.
Intel scheduled a public webcast to discuss its second-quarter results.
Intel provided a third-quarter revenue forecast ranging from 15.8 to 16.8 billion dollars.
Tesla's automotive sales revenue increased 27 percent from the second quarter of the previous year.
Tesla's automotive regulatory-credit revenue declined 67 percent year over year in the second quarter.
Tesla's quarterly automotive leasing revenue decreased 16 percent from a year earlier.
Tesla's quarterly operating income fell from 923 million dollars to 398 million dollars.
Tesla's energy generation and storage revenue increased 13 percent year over year in the quarter.
Tesla's automotive and services segment generated 27 percent more revenue than in the same quarter last year.
Tesla's second-quarter net income declined from 1.190 billion dollars to 1.128 billion dollars.
